title: Shopify Collection Page Walkthrough: Filters, Quick View & Compare | Fuse by UTD
description:

Part 3 of our Fuse walkthrough: the collection list and a single collection page. A banner with a blurred background, a sharp foreground image and a ticker between the layers, pagination or Load more, and any section you want to add. On the collection page: a floating glass header and a sticky toolbar with filters, sorting and a 3, 4 or 6 column grid, mini collections, product cards with quick view and compare, a compare popup, and promo banners right inside the product grid. Fuse is a Shopify theme by UTD on the official Shopify Theme Store.
